# Jabbit - Peptide Tracking App
> Jabbit is a privacy-first iOS app for tracking peptide injections, managing vials, calculating reconstitution, and visualizing serum levels.

## Key Features
- Smart injection tracking with 14-zone site rotation
- Vial management with reconstitution calculator
- Real-time serum level visualization (pharmacokinetic curves)
- Flexible dosing schedules (daily, EOD, 2x/week, 5-on-2-off, custom)
- Titration and cycle planning
- Progress tracking with Apple Health sync
- In-app encyclopedia of peptides with half-life data
- Privacy-first: iCloud sync only, no server storage

## Pricing
- 14-day free trial
- $9.99/year (founding member pricing, normally $19.99/year)

## Study Teardowns
Critical single-study reads: design, comparator, funding, dropout, effect size, enrollment, and durability, with charts rebuilt from published numbers.
- Study teardowns hub: https://jabbitapp.com/research
- CagriSema (cagrilintide + semaglutide) vs Wegovy, Wegovy HD and Zepbound (REDEFINE 1 four-arm results, REDEFINE 4 head-to-head loss to tirzepatide, REIMAGINE 4, dose adherence, safety, FDA decision expected Q4 2026, untested gray-market cagrilintide stacks): https://jabbitapp.com/research/cagrisema-vs-wegovy-zepbound-teardown.html
- GHK-Cu copper peptide paper trail (1973 discovery, ProCyte Iamin trials incl. failed 511-patient Phase III, 510(k) wound-dressing clearance, SEC filings, uncited age-decline claim, Connectivity Map gene claim, PubMed count, FDA injectable concerns): https://jabbitapp.com/research/ghk-cu-copper-peptide-teardown.html
- MOTS-c "exercise in a shot" (FDA review, patents, CohBar CB4211 trial and SEC filings, K14Q variant, PubMed count of 264 records with 0 human dosing studies, mouse-to-human dose scaling): https://jabbitapp.com/research/mots-c-exercise-in-a-shot-teardown.html
- Foundayo (orforglipron) GLP-1 pill vs Wegovy and Zepbound (EU CHMP opinion Oct 2026, US labels, estimands, type 2 diabetes, safety, CYP3A4 interactions): https://jabbitapp.com/research/foundayo-orforglipron-pill-teardown.html
- TB-500 vs thymosin beta-4 (FDA review, full-protein trials, racing-lab chemistry, registry check): https://jabbitapp.com/research/tb-500-thymosin-beta-4-teardown.html
- FDA peptide compounding policy 2026 (BPC-157, semax, epitalon; advisory votes and FDA staff reviews): https://jabbitapp.com/research/fda-peptide-compounding-policy-2026.html
- BPC-157 origins (1989 patent, PubMed authorship count, human proteome scan): https://jabbitapp.com/research/bpc-157-origins-teardown.html
- Epitalon/Thymalin longevity (Khavinson studies, translated): https://jabbitapp.com/research/epitalon-thymalin-khavinson-teardown.html
- Selank anxiety (Russian studies, translated): https://jabbitapp.com/research/selank-anxiety-teardown.html
